entries.german:
Flugblätter aus Studentenvertretungen und Schülervertretungen

Enthält: - Streik des Fachbereichs Erziehungswissenschaften (o.D.) - Asta-Info HfN, Bremen: Ziele und Situation der nautischen Ausbildung (Herbst 1974) - SMV-Bezirk: Hausverbot a. d. Universität Münster (Feb. 1973) - 4 Flugblätter des Streikrats d. FB Erziehungswiss.: Berufsverbot f. Neumann, DKP (Nov./Dez. 1973) - Asta-Info, Universität Münster: Erlass des Kultusministeriums z. Einstellungsverfahren v. Studienreferendaren (03.09.1975) - Demonstration zur Lehrerausbildung (Nov. 1975) - tatsachen, Organ d. Landes-SMV NRW: Bildungspolitik (Dez. 1975) - Elternverein NRW: Einladung zur Diskussion "Schulpolitik morgen" (16.04.1975) - tatsachen, Organ d. Landes-SMV NRW: Berufsverbot für Landesverbindungslehrer Joachim von Rosenberg (o.D.) - Sprachrohr, Organ d. Bezirksschülervertretung MS: Bildungspolitik (o.D.)
entries.english:
Leaflets from student and school student councils

Contains: strike by the Department of Educational Sciences (undated); AStA Info HfN, Bremen: aims and situation of nautical training (autumn 1974); District Student Council: ban from the University of Münster (February 1973); four leaflets by the strike committee of the Department of Educational Sciences: professional ban against Neumann, German Communist Party (November/December 1973); AStA Info, University of Münster: decree by the Ministry of Education on the hiring procedure for trainee teachers (3 September 1975); demonstration on teacher training (November 1975); “tatsachen,” publication of the NRW State Student Council: education policy (December 1975); NRW Parents’ Association: invitation to a discussion, “School Policy Tomorrow” (16 April 1975); “tatsachen,” publication of the NRW State Student Council: professional ban against state liaison teacher Joachim von Rosenberg (undated); “Sprachrohr,” publication of the Münster District Student Council: education policy (undated).
